queries: A man in a green T-shirt talking and gesturing on a professional microphone.
A man first measures one side of a door lying flat with a yellow tape measure, and then measures the other side, finally measures the bottom with a silver ruler.
Three people are chatting in a bedroom, then they come out of the room. Then the video switches to a outdoor scene.
On a clay tennis court, a coach is talking to the camera, then demonstrates a wrong backhand by moving his elbow.
Someone is showing the covers of two comics books, then opens one of them to present the content.
A black man is talking on a microphone to demonstrate a cellphone, then demontrates another cellphone.
A game character holding a sword is walking along a dark corridor and then encounters a monster.
A woman in a white t-shirt stands in a bright kitchen with a stand mixer and baking ingredients in front of her, talking to the camera.
A woman in a blue top talks and gestures to the camera, then looks down at a phone.
A man in a plaid shirt talks and gestures to the camera as a nameplate reading Andy TechSmith appears, then the video switches to a solid yellow screen.
A man in a dark shirt sits at a white desk with three monitors showing mountain scenery, talking and gesturing with his hands.
A man with a beard and a blue cap talks to the camera while gesturing with his hands, with a computer screen displaying audio equipment behind him.
A person plays an acoustic guitar with their left hand forming chords on the fretboard while their right hand strums, as indicated by on-screen chord diagrams and progression text.
A man in scrubs sits on a table, lifts a black dumbbell and talks while demonstrating the movement, then switches to a blue dumbbell.
A man with a beard and glasses, wearing a blue shirt, talks to the camera while gesturing with his hands, with yellow text reading Parameterized curves at the bottom of the screen.
A black screen with a peach-heart logo and the text PEACHES SKINCARE, then a woman in a black tank top appears and speaks.
A woman with dark hair and red lipstick speaks to the camera in front of a microphone.
In front of a green wall, a woman holds up two books while white text reading "*nope- $13 at time of filming" appears on the screen.
A man in a maroon shirt talks and gestures while seated at a keyboard in a green-lit room, then the video switches to a person using a green spreader outdoors.
A person in a swimsuit walks with a green inflatable tube then the video switches to the person riding the tube down a water slide and finally floating in a pool with other people in tubes.
A person in a red shirt plays a guitar while chord names and the text Phrase 4 are displayed on screen.
A man in a blue shirt talks and gestures while seated at a desk with a computer monitor displaying Google Web Stories, and a phone screen showing a webpage appears in the frame.
A woman and a man sit side by side in a room with a bookshelf behind them, both looking at the camera; the woman blinks and closes her eyes briefly then opens them again, while the man speaks.
A young girl in a red-and-white checkered dress stands in front of American flags.
A man wearing a cap sits in a chair and talks to the camera, then holds up a rifle to demonstrate it, then the video switches to a scene of a person shooting at a range.
Cards show C major and D major chords with highlighted yellow keys, under the headings All White Keys C F G and White Black White D E A, then hands play on a full keyboard beneath the same headings.

A woman with curly hair wearing a dark tank top talks to the camera while seated, then the video switches to a screen displaying text about choosing MyWW color plans, then the video switches back to the woman who continues talking.

A man at a desk talks into a microphone, with cameras on the table, then the video switches to a photo of a camera, then cuts back to the man talking, and a warning text overlay reading "WARNING: THIS IS JUST MY GUESS" appears.

A man with glasses and a beard speaks to the camera, then the video switches to a backpack being unzipped, then a laptop is taken out of the backpack, then the person opens the laptop and presses the keyboard, and a title card for 'Valid Sudoku' appears.
A hand presses a French press next to a wine bottle, then pours coffee into a white mug labeled Wifey.

In an animated scene, Minions sit in a ride vehicle, then the video switches to a roller coaster ride through a balloon-filled environment, then shows a colorful amusement park and an indoor street set.

A woman in a pool holds a blue cup above the water, then the video switches to a person swimming, then the video switches to a woman smiling and talking while a man listens in a picture-in-picture window.
A hand displays decorated nails, then the video switches to nail tips being applied, then a lamp cures the applied tips, and the cured nails are shown.
On a blackboard, a hand draws a sun, then draws a watch to the left, then erases everything, and then draws a telescope.

The video shows a list of regions and prices, then switches to a black screen asking what deposit is needed for Help to Buy, then switches to a man with a beard sitting on a blue couch and speaking to the camera.

The video shows a tour of a yacht's interior, starting with a view of the bedroom and shower, then the video switches to a close-up of the bathroom, then the video switches to the bedroom with a TV, then the video switches back to the bathroom, then the video switches to a man climbing stairs.
The video shows a fitness room with motivational neon signs, then switches to an outdoor rooftop park, then finally switches to a man playing a pinball-style arcade game.

The video shows a graphic with a map of Florida and logos for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers and Busch Gardens, then adds the text Pewter Pirate or Creamsicle Crusher, then shows a roller coaster ride, then overlays an NFL logo on a coaster photo with a Who Dat Coaster graphic.
